plan.notes: Source: official SUNY Fredonia 'Computer Science, B.S. Sample Degree Map' (fredonia.edu/degreemap/computer-science-bs), transcribed 2026-09-30 from the page table; course titles copied verbatim from the map (catalog's fuller title for CSIT 311 is 'Assembly Language and Computer Organizations'). Catalog year 2026-2027: the map page carries no year stamp, but its core (CSIT 121/201/221/231/311/321/341/425/431/435/441/455 + CSIT 143 Discrete Mathematics) matches the current catalog's CS core (verified via fredonia.smartcatalogiq.com 2026-2027 current catalog; CSIT 143 is the current number of the former CSIT 241 discrete math course — confirmed by the current JCC-to-Fredonia transfer map, which notes MAT 1670 substitutes for CSIT 143). Printed term totals are 15 credits x 8 semesters; GRAND TOTAL printed on the map: 120. total_credits=120 uses the map's own published grand total (degree minimum is also 120). Choice-slot modeling at 3 credits each: the map lists '(or)' alternates (MATH 122/123 University Calculus I/II are 4 credits, MATH 231 Linear Algebra is 4 credits); students choosing the 4-credit alternates add 1 credit per slot above the 15-credit term totals, documented in each choice_note. FF slots = Fredonia Foundations (gen ed) courses, student choice. 'CSIT XXX Elective' modeled as CSIT elective choice slot. Five 'CSIT XXX Computer Science Track Course' slots = the track requirement (Advanced Computing Track, Software Development Track, or five advisor-approved electives with at least two 400-level). Two 'Required Science Course' slots = two courses from Biology/Chemistry/Geology/Physics per catalog science requirement (3-4 credits each; modeled at 3). Prereqs included only where stated in the official catalog course descriptions, reduced to in-plan codes: CSIT 221: CSIT 121; CSIT 231: CSIT 221; CSIT 311: CSIT 121; CSIT 341: CSIT 205 or CSIT 221 -> CSIT 221; CSIT 425: CSIT 221 or CSIT 205 -> CSIT 221; CSIT 431: (CSIT 311 or CSIT 312) and CSIT 341 and CSIT 231; CSIT 435: CSIT 311 or CSIT 312 or CSIT 335 -> CSIT 311; CSIT 441: catalog lists CSIT 242 and CSIT 341 — CSIT 242 (Discrete Mathematics for CS II) is NOT in the published sample map, so only CSIT 341 is listed here; CSIT 455: CSIT 121. CSIT 321's catalog prerequisite is CSIT 224 (Problem Solving Using Objects), which is not in the published sample map, so its prereq list is intentionally left empty rather than invented. Prereqs for CSIT 121, CSIT 201, CSIT 143, MATH/STAT slots and FF electives were not verified in the official catalog and are left empty (not invented). Catalog note: CSIT 121 and CSIT 221 require a minimum grade of C- or better. The BS degree is 120 hours; students must earn 66 credits outside the major.
